trigger: Re-review at Tier 3, answering finding CG001-MA-CG-04 of RBM003-USDC-0001: an upgradeable proxy was reviewed at Tier 2. Supersedes that decision.
tier_rationale: Tier 3 by construction. RBM-003 section 8 makes any subject behind an upgradeable proxy Tier 3, and RBM003-USDC-0001 established via CG-04 that USDC is upgradeable behind a transparent proxy at the pre-EIP-1967 slots. The two roles omitted from that review, ADA and LQA, were omitted because their gates had no implementation; both are now implemented and tested, so the six-specialist quorum is available rather than waived.
